statement: Pinned Dolphin WriteData assigns InvalidAddress on out-of-range EEPROM writes and always sends the final WriteData ACK carrying that error (input 0x22), rather than a memory-read-result input 0x21. rnconrad routes the analogous out-of-range write through a memory-result/error reply. The two source-side implementations differ in report type; no physical-device outcome is established.

applicability.revision: Historical independent software emulators, not physical hardware revisions
applicability.scope: EmuSubroutines.cpp lines 280-283 and 321-322; source implementation difference, not physical negative-response evidence.
